entries.title: A task with parts now draws as moons round a growing gem
entries.body: When a task runs in parts, its running crewmates now circle the task's ring on a tilted orbit of their own, like moons, in place of a fan of branches. A gem inside the ring gains a wire each time part of the work finishes, and is whole when the task is done. A finished part's result flies straight to the ring and lights it. The same look appears on your iPhone and iPad.

picture.alt: The first mate with a task's ring beside it: two crewmates circle the ring on a faint tilted orbit, and a small gem turns inside the ring
